description: Hobart Stormwater - Drainage Branch Connection is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Tasmania Government's The List Data. The Drainage Connections data set is a series of vectors or lines depicting the connections provided for a property to the drainage network. This may be an underground pipe or to a kerb in the roadway. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Tasmania Government's The List Data. Its tags are UTILITIES-Any, WATER-Surface. The portal shows 2025-11-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
